label: TP
reason: User-provided query string parameter flows through substring extraction and URL decoding into bar variable, which is then included in obj array passed to response.getWriter().format() at line 93. The switch statement evaluates to case 'C' (from guess.charAt(2) where guess="ABC"), setting bar=param. No HTML encoding occurs before formatting to response, creating XSS vulnerability.
